question.en: Which one supports Server Components?

explanation.ar: وكمان Layouts متداخلة و Streaming.
explanation.en: It also has nested layouts and streaming.

question.ar: component فيه useState محتاج إيه؟
question.en: What does a component using useState need?

options.en: "use client" at the top of the file
"use server" at the top of the file
To be placed in the pages folder

explanation.ar: الـ Server Components مبتدعمش state ولا events.
explanation.en: Server Components do not support state or events.

question.ar: بتتحكم في الـ caching في fetch إزاي؟
question.en: How do you control caching with fetch?

options.ar: بخيارات زي cache و next: { revalidate }
options.en: With options like cache and next: { revalidate }

explanation.ar: الـ fetch بيتعمل جوه الـ Server Component نفسه.
explanation.en: fetch runs inside the Server Component itself.

question.ar: [...slug] بيعمل إيه؟
question.en: What does [...slug] do?

options.ar: بيلقط أكتر من جزء في الـ URL (catch-all)

explanation.ar: [id] بيلقط جزء واحد.
explanation.en: [id] catches a single segment.

question.ar: إيه اللي بيحصل للـ layout لما تتنقل بين الصفحات اللي تحته؟
question.en: What happens to a layout when navigating between its child pages?

options.ar: مبيعملش re-render والـ state بيفضل محفوظ
options.en: It does not re-render and its state is preserved
It turns into a Client Component

explanation.ar: ده اللي بيخليه مناسب للـ Navbar.
explanation.en: That is why it suits a navbar.

question.ar: Server Actions بتتعلّم بإيه؟
question.en: How are Server Actions marked?

explanation.ar: وبتتستخدم في الـ mutations.
explanation.en: They are used for mutations.

question.ar: أنهي حاجة من دول بيعملها next/image؟
question.en: Which of these does next/image do?

options.ar: lazy loading ومنع الـ layout shift
options.en: Lazy loading and preventing layout shift

explanation.ar: وده بيحسّن الـ Core Web Vitals.
explanation.en: This improves Core Web Vitals.

question.ar: ملف الـ Middleware بيتحط فين؟
question.en: Where does the Middleware file go?

explanation.ar: وبيشتغل قبل ما الـ request يوصل للصفحة.
explanation.en: It runs before the request reaches the page.

question.ar: بتحدد العنوان والوصف لكل صفحة بإيه؟
question.en: How do you set each page's title and description?

explanation.ar: ومع SSR أو SSG محركات البحث بتشوف المحتوى كامل.
explanation.en: With SSR or SSG, crawlers see the full content.

question.ar: loading.js بيعتمد على إيه؟
question.en: What does loading.js rely on?

explanation.ar: error.js هو اللي بيمسك الأخطاء.
explanation.en: error.js is the one that catches errors.

question.ar: ليه التنقل بـ Link أسرع من <a>؟
question.en: Why is navigation with Link faster than with <a>?

options.ar: client-side navigation مع prefetch للصفحات الظاهرة
options.en: Client-side navigation plus prefetching of visible routes
Because it only runs on the server

explanation.ar: الـ <a> العادي بيحمّل الصفحة من الأول.
explanation.en: A plain <a> reloads the whole page.

question.ar: عشان المتغير يبقى متاح في المتصفح لازم يبدأ بإيه؟
question.en: What prefix makes an environment variable available in the browser?

explanation.ar: من غير البادئة دي المتغير على السيرفر بس.
explanation.en: Without that prefix it stays server-only.

question.ar: أنهي حاجة ممكن تعمل Hydration Error؟
question.en: Which of these can cause a hydration error?

explanation.ar: القيمة بتختلف بين السيرفر والمتصفح.
explanation.en: The value differs between server and client.

short.ar: بيئة تشغيل للـ JavaScript على السيرفر، مبنية على محرك V8 بتاع كروم.
short.en: A JavaScript runtime built on Chrome's V8 engine that lets you run JS on the server.

ar: بيئة تشغيل للـ JavaScript على السيرفر، مبنية على محرك V8 بتاع كروم.
بتخليك تكتب الـ backend بنفس لغة الـ frontend.
en: A JavaScript runtime built on Chrome's V8 engine.
It lets you run JS on the server, so the back end uses the same language as the front end.

try.ar: غيّر اسم الملف أو زوّد وقت الـ setTimeout وشوف إن سطر 2 لسه بيتطبع الأول.
try.en: Change the file name or raise the setTimeout delay and notice line 2 still prints first.

title.ar: هل Node.js شغال بـ thread واحد؟

short.ar: كودك بيشتغل على thread واحد، لكن الـ I/O بيتنفذ في الخلفية عن طريق libuv.
short.en: Your JS runs on a single thread, but I/O is offloaded to libuv's thread pool.

ar: كودك بيشتغل على thread واحد.
عمليات الـ I/O بتتنفذ في الخلفية عن طريق libuv thread pool.
علشان كده بيتعامل مع طلبات كتير في نفس الوقت.
en: Your JS code runs on a single thread.
I/O is offloaded to libuv's thread pool.
So it handles many requests concurrently.

try.ar: بدّل Promise.all بـ await ورا بعض وشوف الوقت بقى 300ms.
try.en: Replace Promise.all with sequential awaits and see the time become about 300ms.

short.ar: الآلية اللي بتخلي Node.js غير معطّل (non-blocking).
short.en: The mechanism that makes Node non-blocking.

ar: هو الآلية اللي بتخلي Node.js غير معطّل (non-blocking).
بيراقب الـ call stack، ولما يفضى بياخد الـ callbacks الجاهزة من الطوابير وينفذها.
en: The mechanism that makes Node non-blocking.
It watches the call stack and, when it is empty, pushes ready callbacks from the queues onto it.

try.ar: ضيف setTimeout تاني بـ 0 وPromise جواه وشوف الترتيب.
try.en: Add a second setTimeout(0) containing a Promise and see how the order changes.

title.ar: إيه الفرق بين Blocking و Non-blocking؟

short.ar: الـ blocking بيوقف الكود لحد ما العملية تخلص، والـ non-blocking بيكمل ويرجّع النتيجة بعدين.
short.en: Blocking halts execution until the operation finishes; non-blocking continues and returns the result later.

ar: الـ blocking بيوقف الكود لحد ما العملية تخلص، زي readFileSync.
الـ non-blocking بيكمل تنفيذ وبيرجّع النتيجة بعدين، زي readFile.
en: Blocking halts execution until the operation finishes (readFileSync).
Non-blocking continues and returns the result later (readFile).

try.ar: قلّل مدة blockingWait لـ 0 وشوف الفرق في ترتيب الطباعة.
try.en: Set blockingWait to 0 and compare the print order.

title.ar: إيه الفرق بين Callbacks و Promises و async/await؟

short.ar: الـ callback بيتنادى بعد العملية، الـ Promise نتيجة مستقبلية، و async/await صياغة أنضف فوق الـ Promises.
short.en: Callbacks run after an operation, Promises represent a future value, and async/await is cleaner syntax over Promises.

ar: الـ callback دالة بتتنادى بعد انتهاء العملية، وممكن توصل لـ callback hell.
الـ Promise بيمثل نتيجة مستقبلية وبيسهّل الـ chaining.
async/await صياغة أنضف فوق الـ Promises بتخلي الكود شبه المتزامن.
en: Callbacks run after an operation completes and can lead to callback hell.
Promises represent a future value and support chaining.
async/await is cleaner syntax over Promises that reads like synchronous code.

try.ar: خلّي getOrders ترمي Error وشوف catch في كل أسلوب.
try.en: Make getOrders throw an Error and see how each style catches it.

short.ar: بينفذ الـ callback بعد العملية الحالية مباشرة وقبل أي حاجة تانية في الـ event loop.
short.en: Runs the callback right after the current operation, before the event loop continues.

ar: بينفذ الـ callback بعد العملية الحالية مباشرة وقبل أي حاجة تانية في الـ event loop.
يعني قبل الـ Promises والـ timers.
en: Runs the callback right after the current operation, before the event loop continues.
So it executes before promises and timers.

try.ar: جرب الكود في Node حقيقي بـ process.nextTick وشوف إنه بيسبق الـ Promise.
try.en: Run it in real Node with process.nextTick and see it run before the Promise.

title.ar: إيه الفرق بين setImmediate و setTimeout(fn, 0)؟

short.ar: setImmediate في مرحلة الـ check، و setTimeout في مرحلة الـ timers.
short.en: setImmediate runs in the check phase; setTimeout runs in the timers phase.

ar: الـ setImmediate بيتنفذ في مرحلة الـ check بعد الـ I/O.
الـ setTimeout بيتنفذ في مرحلة الـ timers.
خارج الـ I/O callback الترتيب بينهم مش مضمون.
en: setImmediate runs in the check phase, after I/O.
setTimeout runs in the timers phase.
Outside an I/O callback, the order is not guaranteed.

try.ar: جرب في Node حقيقي setTimeout وsetImmediate جوه fs.readFile callback.
try.en: In real Node, try setTimeout and setImmediate inside an fs.readFile callback.

short.ar: طريقة لقراءة أو كتابة الداتا على أجزاء (chunks) بدل تحميلها كلها في الميموري.
short.en: A way to process data in chunks instead of loading everything into memory.

ar: طريقة لقراءة أو كتابة الداتا على أجزاء (chunks) بدل تحميلها كلها في الميموري.
مفيدة جدًا مع الملفات الكبيرة.
أنواعها: Readable و Writable و Duplex و Transform.
en: A way to process data in chunks instead of loading everything into memory.
Ideal for large files.
Types: Readable, Writable, Duplex, Transform.

try.ar: ضيف stage تالتة بتحذف الـ header قبل الطباعة.
try.en: Add a third stage that drops the header line before printing.

short.ar: دالة بتشتغل بين الـ request والـ response وبتاخد (req, res, next).
short.en: A function between request and response that receives (req, res, next).

ar: دالة بتشتغل بين الـ request والـ response وبتاخد (req, res, next).
تقدر تعدّل الـ request أو تنهي الدورة أو تنادي next() علشان تكمل.
en: A function between request and response that receives (req, res, next).
It can modify the request, end the cycle, or call next() to continue.

try.ar: شيل next() من الـ logger وشوف الـ request بيتوقف.
try.en: Remove next() from the logger and watch the request stop.

title.ar: إيه الفرق بين require و import؟

short.ar: require تبع CommonJS و sync، و import تبع ES Modules وبيدعم tree-shaking.
short.en: require is CommonJS and synchronous; import is ES Modules and supports tree-shaking.

ar: require تبع CommonJS وبيحمّل الموديول بشكل متزامن.
import تبع ES Modules وبيدعم الـ tree-shaking وبيشتغل بشكل غير متزامن.
en: require is CommonJS and loads modules synchronously.
import is ES Modules, supports tree-shaking, and loads asynchronously.

try.ar: ضيف ملف تاني بيعمل require للـ math وشوف إن الـ log بيظهر مرة واحدة بس.
try.en: Add a second file that requires math and see the log prints only once.

title.ar: إيه الفرق بين package.json و package-lock.json؟

short.ar: package.json فيه بيانات المشروع ونطاقات الإصدارات، و package-lock.json بيثبّت الإصدارات بالظبط.
short.en: package.json holds metadata and version ranges; package-lock.json locks exact versions.

ar: package.json فيه بيانات المشروع والـ dependencies بنطاقات إصدارات.
package-lock.json بيثبّت الإصدارات بالظبط علشان نفس التثبيت يطلع في أي مكان.
en: package.json holds project metadata and version ranges.
package-lock.json locks exact versions for reproducible installs.

try.ar: ضيف 4.19.0 للـ registry وشوف الـ lock بيتغير لما نعمل install جديد.
try.en: Add 4.19.0 to the registry and see which version a fresh install would pin.

title.ar: إيه الفرق بين dependencies و devDependencies؟

short.ar: dependencies محتاجها وقت التشغيل، و devDependencies للتطوير بس.
short.en: dependencies are needed at runtime; devDependencies are for development only.

ar: dependencies محتاجها وقت التشغيل في الـ production.
devDependencies للتطوير بس، زي أدوات الـ testing والـ linting.
en: dependencies are needed at runtime in production.
devDependencies are for development only, like testing and linting tools.

title.en: What is NestJS and why use it?

short.ar: NestJS فريمورك لـ Node.js مبني على TypeScript.
short.en: NestJS is a progressive Node.js framework built with TypeScript.

ar: NestJS فريمورك لـ Node.js مبني على TypeScript.
بيعتمد على معمارية Modules زي Angular ومعاه Dependency Injection جاهز.
بيشتغل فوق Express أو Fastify.
بيدّي المشروع الكبير تنظيم وسهولة في التوسع والاختبار.
en: NestJS is a progressive Node.js framework built with TypeScript.
It uses a modular architecture inspired by Angular, with built-in Dependency Injection.
It runs on top of Express or Fastify.
It gives large projects structure, scalability and testability.

title.en: What are the main building blocks?

short.ar: Modules و Controllers و Providers (Services).
short.en: Modules, Controllers and Providers (Services).

ar: الـ Modules بتنظّم التطبيق.
الـ Controllers بتستقبل الـ requests وترجّع الـ responses.
الـ Providers (الـ Services) فيها الـ business logic وبتتحقن (inject) في أي مكان محتاجها.
en: Modules organize the app.
Controllers handle incoming requests and return responses.
Providers (Services) hold the business logic and are injected where needed.

try.en: Add a new route "GET /cats/count" to the controller.

short.ar: الـ class بتطلب الـ dependencies في الـ constructor والـ IoC container بتنشئها وتحقنها.
short.en: The class declares its needs in the constructor and Nest's IoC container creates and injects them.

ar: بدل ما أعمل new للـ dependency بنفسي، الـ class بتطلبها في الـ constructor.
الـ IoC container بتاعة Nest هي اللي بتنشئها وتحقنها.
ده بيخلي الكود مش مترابط ببعضه (loosely coupled) وسهل أعمل له mock في الاختبار.
en: Instead of creating dependencies with new, the class declares what it needs in its constructor.
Nest's IoC container creates and injects them.
This keeps the code loosely coupled and easy to mock in tests.

title.ar: إيه معنى imports و exports و providers و controllers في الـ Module؟
title.en: What do imports, exports, providers and controllers mean in a module?

short.ar: أربع خصائص بتحدد الـ module بيعمل إيه وبيشارك إيه.
short.en: Four properties that define what a module creates and shares.

ar: providers: الـ services اللي الـ module بينشئها.
controllers: الـ route handlers بتاعته.
exports: الـ providers اللي مسموح للـ modules التانية تستخدمها.
imports: الـ modules اللي محتاج أستخدم الـ providers اللي بتصدّرها.
en: providers: the services this module instantiates.
controllers: its route handlers.
exports: the providers other modules may use.
imports: the modules whose exported providers this module needs.

title.en: What is the request lifecycle order?

ar: Middleware
Guards
Interceptors (قبل الـ handler)
Pipes
Controller handler
Service
Interceptors (بعد الـ handler)
Exception Filters (لو حصل error)
en: Middleware
Guards
Interceptors (before)
Pipes
Controller handler
Service
Interceptors (after)
Exception Filters (if an error is thrown)

try.en: Reorder the pipeline and recall the real order used by Nest.

title.ar: إيه الفرق بين Guard و Middleware و Interceptor و Pipe؟
title.en: What is the difference between Guard, Middleware, Interceptor and Pipe?

short.ar: كل واحد ليه دور مختلف في معالجة الـ request.
short.en: Each plays a different role in handling a request.

ar: Middleware: بيشتغل قبل الـ routing ومعندوش وصول لـ execution context.
Guard: بيقرر الـ request يعدّي ولا لأ (authentication و authorization).
Interceptor: بيلفّ حوالين الـ handler عشان يعدّل الـ response أو يعمل logging أو caching.
Pipe: بيحوّل أو بيتحقق من صحة الـ input.
en: Middleware: runs before routing, with no access to the execution context.
Guard: decides whether the request may proceed (authentication and authorization).
Interceptor: wraps the handler to transform the response, add logging or add caching.
Pipe: transforms or validates input data.

try.ar: غيّر الـ token في الطلب الأخير وشوف مين فيهم بيرفض الطلب.

short.ar: DTO class بـ decorators من class-validator مع ValidationPipe.
short.en: A DTO class with class-validator decorators plus ValidationPipe.

ar: بعمل DTO class وأحط عليها decorators من class-validator زي @IsEmail() و @IsString().
بعدين أستخدم ValidationPipe على مستوى التطبيق كله أو على route معين.
لو فعّلت whitelist: true بيشيل أي خصائص مش معرّفة في الـ DTO.
en: Create a DTO class with class-validator decorators such as @IsEmail() and @IsString().
Apply ValidationPipe, globally or per route.
whitelist: true strips any properties not defined in the DTO.

short.ar: DEFAULT و REQUEST و TRANSIENT.
short.en: DEFAULT, REQUEST and TRANSIENT.

ar: DEFAULT (singleton): نسخة واحدة مشتركة في التطبيق كله.
REQUEST: نسخة جديدة مع كل request.
TRANSIENT: نسخة جديدة لكل class بتعمل لها inject.
الـ Request scope بيأثر على الأداء، فبستخدمه بس لما أكون محتاجه فعلًا.
en: DEFAULT (singleton): one instance shared across the whole app.
REQUEST: a new instance for every request.
TRANSIENT: a new instance for every class that injects it.
Request-scoped providers hurt performance, so use them only when needed.

title.en: How do you solve circular dependencies?

short.ar: بـ forwardRef()، بس الأفضل إعادة تصميم الكود.
short.en: With forwardRef(), though refactoring is the better fix.

ar: بستخدم forwardRef() في الـ imports وفي الـ injection جوه الـ constructor.
لكن الحل الأفضل هو إعادة تصميم الكود، بإني أطلّع الـ logic المشترك في module أو service تالت.
en: Use forwardRef() in both the module imports and the constructor injection.
The better fix is to refactor: extract the shared logic into a third module or service.

title.en: How do you implement authentication and authorization?

short.ar: JWT بـ @nestjs/passport أو @nestjs/jwt، و AuthGuard، و RolesGuard للـ authorization.
short.en: JWT via @nestjs/passport or @nestjs/jwt, AuthGuard, and a RolesGuard for authorization.

ar: بستخدم @nestjs/passport مع JWT strategy، أو @nestjs/jwt مباشرة.
بطلع token عند الـ login وبحمي الـ routes بـ AuthGuard عن طريق @UseGuards().
للـ authorization بعمل RolesGuard مخصص بيقرأ الـ metadata من decorator اسمه @Roles() عن طريق Reflector.
en: Use @nestjs/passport with a JWT strategy, or @nestjs/jwt directly.
Issue a token on login, then protect routes with AuthGuard through @UseGuards().
For authorization, add a custom RolesGuard that reads metadata set by a @Roles() decorator through Reflector.

try.ar: خلي الـ guard يقبل role "user" كمان وشوف التغيير.
try.en: Let the guard also accept the "user" role and see what changes.

short.ar: برمي exceptions جاهزة، ولو محتاج تخصيص بعمل Exception Filter.
short.en: Throw built-in exceptions, and use an Exception Filter for custom handling.

ar: برمي exceptions جاهزة زي NotFoundException أو BadRequestException، وكلها بترث من HttpException.
لو عاوز شكل رد مخصص أو logging، بعمل Exception Filter بـ @Catch() وأطبّقه على مستوى التطبيق.
en: Throw built-in exceptions such as NotFoundException or BadRequestException, which extend HttpException.
For custom formatting or logging, create an Exception Filter with @Catch() and apply it globally.

short.en: Modules that accept configuration at import time through static methods.

ar: modules بتاخد إعدادات وقت الـ import من خلال static methods زي forRoot() و forRootAsync() و register().
مثال: TypeOrmModule.forRoot({...}) أو ConfigModule.forRoot().
en: Modules that accept configuration at import time through static methods such as forRoot(), forRootAsync() and register().
For example TypeOrmModule.forRoot({...}) or ConfigModule.forRoot().

title.en: How do you test a NestJS app?

short.ar: Jest مع Test.createTestingModule() للـ unit tests و supertest للـ e2e.
short.en: Jest with Test.createTestingModule() for unit tests and supertest for e2e.

ar: بستخدم Jest.
في الـ unit tests بعمل module معزول بـ Test.createTestingModule() وبستبدل الـ dependencies الحقيقية بـ mocks عن طريق useValue.
في الـ e2e tests بستخدم supertest على نسخة كاملة من التطبيق.
en: Use Jest.
For unit tests, build an isolated module with Test.createTestingModule() and replace real dependencies with mocks through useValue.
For e2e tests, use supertest against the full app instance.

title.en: What is the difference between @Injectable() and @Inject()?

short.ar: @Injectable() بتعلّم الـ class كـ provider، و @Inject() بتحدد الـ token يدويًا.
short.en: @Injectable() marks a class as a provider; @Inject() sets the injection token manually.

ar: @Injectable() بتعلّم الـ class إنها provider ممكن الـ container تديرها.
@Inject() بتحدد الـ token يدويًا.
بنحتاجها مع الـ custom providers أو الـ interfaces (زي لما أعمل inject لـ string أو symbol token).
en: @Injectable() marks a class as a provider the container can manage.
@Inject() specifies the injection token manually.
It is needed for custom providers or interfaces (e.g. a string or symbol token).

title.ar: إيه هي PHP والكود بيتنفذ إزاي؟
title.en: What is PHP and how is its code executed?

short.ar: لغة سكريبت بتشتغل على السيرفر وبتستخدم في الويب.
short.en: A server-side scripting language used for the web.

ar: الكود بيتحول لـ tokens ثم AST ثم Opcodes، والـ Zend Engine بينفذها، والناتج بيروح للمتصفح.
وفي الويب العادي كل طلب بيبدأ بحالة جديدة.
en: Code becomes tokens, then an AST, then opcodes, which the Zend Engine runs; the output goes to the browser.
In a typical web setup every request starts from a fresh state.

example.code:
<?php
// Simulation: PHP runs per request - the script starts, runs, dies, nothing is shared
function handleRequest(string $path, array $query): string {
    $visits = 0;            // fresh on every request (shared-nothing)
    $visits++;
    $name = $query['name'] ?? 'guest';
    return "Path: $path | Hello $name | visits this request: $visits";
}
echo handleRequest('/home', ['name' => 'Sara']) . "\n"; // Path: /home | Hello Sara | visits this request: 1
echo handleRequest('/home', []) . "\n";                 // Path: /home | Hello guest | visits this request: 1
echo 'PHP major version >= 8: ' . (PHP_MAJOR_VERSION >= 8 ? 'yes' : 'no') . "\n"; // yes

try.ar: غيّر $visits لـ static وشوف إزاي القيمة بتفضل بين النداءات، وده عكس الـ request الحقيقي.
try.en: Make $visits static and see the value persist between calls - unlike a real new request.

title.en: What are the data types, and what is type juggling?

short.ar: int و float و string و bool و array و object و null وغيرهم، و PHP بتحول بينهم تلقائيًا.
short.en: int, float, string, bool, array, object, null and more, and PHP converts between them automatically.

ar: فيه كمان callable و iterable و resource.
ولمنع التحويل التلقائي في تمرير القيم استخدم declare(strict_types=1).
en: There are also callable, iterable and resource.
To stop automatic conversion when passing values, use declare(strict_types=1).

lessons.code:
declare(strict_types=1);
echo "5" + 3; // 8

example.code:
<?php
$price = "100";          // string from a form
$qty = 3;
var_dump($price + $qty);        // int(103)  - string is converted
var_dump("10" == "1e1");        // bool(true)  - numeric strings compare as numbers
var_dump(0 == "abc");           // bool(false) in PHP 8 (was true in PHP 7)
var_dump((int) "12.9abc");      // int(12)
var_dump((bool) "0");           // bool(false)
var_dump((bool) "0.0");         // bool(true)
var_dump(gettype(1 + 1.5));     // string(6) "double"

try.ar: جرب (bool) "" و (bool) [] و (bool) "false" وشوف أنهي واحدة true.
try.en: Try (bool) "", (bool) [] and (bool) "false" and see which are true.

title.en: What is the difference between == and ===?

short.ar: الأولى بتقارن القيمة بعد التحويل، والتانية القيمة والنوع.
short.en: The first compares values after conversion; the second compares value and type.

ar: في PHP 8 مقارنة رقم بنص غير رقمي بقت منطقية أكتر.
en: In PHP 8, comparing a number with a non-numeric string became more sensible.

lessons.code:
1 == "1";   // true
1 === "1";  // false
0 == "abc"; // false in PHP 8

example.code:
<?php
var_dump(0 == "abc");        // bool(false) in PHP 8
var_dump("1" == "01");       // bool(true)  - both numeric
var_dump("100" == "1e2");    // bool(true)
var_dump(null == false);     // bool(true)
var_dump(null === false);    // bool(false)
var_dump("1" === "01");      // bool(false)
var_dump(in_array("abc", [0]));          // bool(false) in PHP 8
var_dump(in_array("1e1", ["10"]));       // bool(true)  - loose
var_dump(in_array("1e1", ["10"], true)); // bool(false) - strict

try.ar: ضيف true كـ parameter تالت لـ in_array في أي مثال وشوف النتيجة.
try.en: Pass true as the third argument of in_array elsewhere and see the result.

title.ar: echo و print و print_r و var_dump؟

short.ar: الأولين للطباعة، والباقيين لفحص البيانات.
short.en: The first two print output; the other two inspect data.

ar: echo تقبل كذا قيمة ومبترجعش حاجة.
print بترجع 1.
print_r بتعرض محتوى مقروء.
var_dump بتعرض النوع والقيمة.
en: echo accepts several values and returns nothing.
print returns 1.
print_r shows readable contents.
var_dump shows the type and the value.

example.code:
<?php
$user = ['id' => 7, 'name' => 'Omar', 'active' => true, 'score' => 9.5];
echo "Name: {$user['name']}\n";   // Name: Omar
$r = print "printed\n";           // printed
echo "print returns: $r\n";       // print returns: 1
echo 'a', 'b', "\n";              // ab  - echo accepts many args
print_r($user);                   // readable array
var_dump($user);                  // types + sizes
$text = print_r($user, true);     // print_r can return a string instead of printing
echo strlen($text) > 0 ? "captured\n" : '';

try.ar: غيّر active لـ false وشوف الفرق بين print_r و var_dump في عرضها.
try.en: Set active to false and see how print_r and var_dump display it differently.

short.ar: require بتوقف السكريبت لو فشلت، و include بتطلع Warning وتكمل.
short.en: require stops the script if it fails; include raises a warning and carries on.

ar: النسخ _once بتتأكد إن الملف ميتضمنش أكتر من مرة.
en: The _once variants make sure a file is included only once.

lessons.code: require_once __DIR__ . '/config.php';

example.code:
<?php
// Simulation: include vs require when the file is missing
function load(string $file, bool $required): void {
    if (!file_exists($file)) {
        if ($required) {
            throw new Error("Failed opening required '$file' (fatal)");
        }
        echo "Warning: '$file' not found, continuing\n";
        return;
    }
    echo "loaded $file\n";
}
load('config.php', false);          // Warning: 'config.php' not found, continuing
try {
    load('config.php', true);
} catch (Error $e) {
    echo $e->getMessage() . "\n";   // Failed opening required 'config.php' (fatal)
}
load(__FILE__, true);               // loaded <this file>
// Real code: include_once / require_once prevent loading the same file twice

try.ar: غيّر اسم الملف لـ __FILE__ وشوف إنه بيتحمل عادي.
try.en: Change the missing file name to __FILE__ and see it loads fine.

short.ar: isset موجود ومش null، empty فاضي أو falsy، is_null قيمته null.
short.en: isset: exists and is not null; empty: empty or falsy; is_null: the value is null.

ar: empty بترجع true لـ "" و "0" و 0 و [] و false و null.
و is_null على متغير مش معرف بتطلع Warning.
en: empty returns true for "", "0", 0, [], false and null.
is_null on an undefined variable raises a warning.

example.code:
<?php
$data = ['name' => 'Ali', 'age' => 0, 'email' => null, 'bio' => ''];
foreach (['name', 'age', 'email', 'bio', 'phone'] as $k) {
    printf("%-6s isset=%s empty=%s\n", $k,
        isset($data[$k]) ? 'T' : 'F',
        empty($data[$k]) ? 'T' : 'F');
}
// name   isset=T empty=F
// age    isset=T empty=T
// email  isset=F empty=T
// bio    isset=T empty=T
// phone  isset=F empty=T
var_dump(is_null($data['email']));          // bool(true)
var_dump(array_key_exists('email', $data)); // bool(true)

try.ar: غيّر age لـ "0.0" وشوف empty بترجع إيه.
try.en: Change age to "0.0" and see what empty returns.

short.ar: متغيرات متاحة في كل مكان.
short.en: Variables available everywhere.

ar: $_GET و $_POST و $_REQUEST و $_SERVER و $_SESSION و $_COOKIE و $_FILES و $_ENV و $GLOBALS.
وأي مدخل من المستخدم متثقش فيه.
en: $_GET, $_POST, $_REQUEST, $_SERVER, $_SESSION, $_COOKIE, $_FILES, $_ENV and $GLOBALS.
Never trust any input that comes from the user.

example.code:
<?php
// Simulation: superglobals filled by hand (CLI has no real request)
$_GET = ['page' => '2', 'q' => 'laptop'];
$_POST = ['email' => 'a@b.com'];
$_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] = 'GET';
function show(): void {            // superglobals are visible inside functions
    echo "Method: {$_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD']}\n";        // Method: GET
    echo "Page: " . ($_GET['page'] ?? 1) . "\n";          // Page: 2
    echo "Email: " . ($_POST['email'] ?? 'none') . "\n";  // Email: a@b.com
}
show();
$page = max(1, (int) ($_GET['page'] ?? 1)); // always sanitize
echo "Offset: " . (($page - 1) * 10) . "\n"; // Offset: 10

try.ar: غيّر page لـ "abc" وشوف إزاي (int) بيحميك.
try.en: Change page to "abc" and see how (int) protects you.

short.ar: GET للقراءة والبيانات في الـ URL، و POST للإرسال في الـ body.
short.en: GET is for reading, with data in the URL; POST sends data in the body.

ar: GET ينفع يتعمل له cache و bookmark.
POST أنسب للتعديل، بس مش مشفر من غير HTTPS.
en: GET can be cached and bookmarked.
POST suits changes, but it is not encrypted without HTTPS.

example.code:
<?php
// Simulation: GET puts data in the URL, POST in the body
$params = ['q' => 'red shoes', 'page' => 2];
$url = '/search?' . http_build_query($params);
echo "GET  $url\n";   // GET  /search?q=red+shoes&page=2
parse_str('email=a%40b.com&pass=123', $body);
echo "POST body parsed:\n";
print_r($body);       // [email] => a@b.com  [pass] => 123
echo "Password in URL? " . (str_contains($url, 'pass') ? 'yes' : 'no') . "\n"; // no

try.ar: ضيف password للـ $params وشوف إزاي بيظهر في الـ URL (وده غلط).
try.en: Add a password to $params and see it leak into the URL (bad idea).

short.ar: الـ Session في السيرفر، والـ Cookie في المتصفح.
short.en: A session lives on the server; a cookie lives in the browser.

ar: المتصفح غالبًا بيشيل session ID بس في cookie.
اعمل تجديد للـ ID بعد تسجيل الدخول.
en: The browser usually holds only the session ID, in a cookie.
Regenerate the ID after login.

example.code:
<?php
// Simulation: session data lives on the server, the cookie holds only the id
$serverSessions = [];
function startSession(array &$store): string {
    $id = bin2hex(random_bytes(4));
    $store[$id] = ['user' => 'Mona', 'cart' => []];
    return $id;                    // this id is what goes in the cookie
}
$cookie = startSession($serverSessions);
$serverSessions[$cookie]['cart'][] = 'Keyboard';
echo "Cookie length: " . strlen($cookie) . "\n";                        // Cookie length: 8
echo "Server knows: " . $serverSessions[$cookie]['user'] . "\n";        // Server knows: Mona
echo "Cart: " . implode(', ', $serverSessions[$cookie]['cart']) . "\n"; // Cart: Keyboard
unset($serverSessions[$cookie]);   // logout = destroy server side
echo "After logout: " . count($serverSessions) . " sessions\n";         // After logout: 0 sessions

try.ar: ضيف عنصر تاني للـ cart وشوف implode.
try.en: Add another item to the cart and see the implode output.

title.en: Passing by value versus by reference?

short.ar: الأولى نسخة، والتانية نفس المتغير باستخدام &.
short.en: By value passes a copy; by reference passes the same variable, using &.

ar: الـ objects بيتمرر الـ handle بتاعها، فتعديل خصائصها بيظهر بره.
en: Objects pass their handle, so changes to their properties are visible outside.

lessons.code:
function inc(int &$n): void { $n++; }
$x = 1; inc($x); // 2

example.code:
<?php
function addTaxCopy(array $prices): array {
    foreach ($prices as $i => $p) $prices[$i] = $p * 1.1;
    return $prices;
}
function addTaxRef(array &$prices): void {
    foreach ($prices as $i => $p) $prices[$i] = $p * 1.1;
}
$cart = [100, 200];
addTaxCopy($cart);
echo implode(', ', $cart) . "\n";  // 100, 200  - unchanged
addTaxRef($cart);
echo implode(', ', $cart) . "\n";  // 110, 220  - changed in place
$a = [1, 2, 3];
foreach ($a as &$v) { $v *= 2; }
unset($v);                          // avoid the classic dangling-reference bug
echo implode(', ', $a) . "\n";     // 2, 4, 6

try.ar: شيل unset($v) وضيف foreach تاني بدون & وشوف الـ bug.
try.en: Remove unset($v) and add a second foreach without & to see the classic bug.

title.en: What kinds of arrays are there?

short.ar: Indexed و Associative و Multidimensional.
short.en: Indexed, associative and multidimensional.

ar: Indexed مفاتيحه أرقام بتبدأ من 0.
Associative مفاتيحه نصوص بتختارها.
Multidimensional هو array جواه arrays.
en: Indexed arrays have numeric keys starting at 0.
Associative arrays have string keys you choose.
Multidimensional arrays contain other arrays.

example.code:
<?php
$list = ['apple', 'banana'];                    // indexed
$user = ['name' => 'Hana', 'age' => 28];        // associative
$orders = [                                      // multidimensional
    ['id' => 1, 'total' => 50],
    ['id' => 2, 'total' => 75],
];
$list[] = 'cherry';
echo count($list) . "\n";                       // 3
echo $user['name'] . "\n";                      // Hana
echo array_sum(array_column($orders, 'total')) . "\n"; // 125
echo $orders[1]['id'] . "\n";                   // 2
var_dump(array_is_list($list), array_is_list($user)); // bool(true) bool(false)

try.ar: اعمل unset($list[0]) وشوف array_is_list بترجع إيه.
try.en: Run unset($list[0]) and see what array_is_list returns.

short.ar: تحويل، وتصفية، وتجميع.
short.en: Transform, filter and accumulate.

ar: array_filter بتحافظ على المفاتيح، فاستخدم array_values لإعادة الترقيم.
en: array_filter keeps the original keys, so use array_values to renumber them.

example.code:
<?php
$products = [
    ['name' => 'Laptop', 'price' => 1000, 'stock' => 5],
    ['name' => 'Mouse',  'price' => 20,   'stock' => 0],
    ['name' => 'Screen', 'price' => 300,  'stock' => 2],
];
$inStock = array_filter($products, fn($p) => $p['stock'] > 0);
$names = array_map(fn($p) => strtoupper($p['name']), $inStock);
$value = array_reduce($inStock, fn($sum, $p) => $sum + $p['price'] * $p['stock'], 0);
echo implode(', ', $names) . "\n";        // LAPTOP, SCREEN
echo $value . "\n";                       // 5600
echo implode(', ', array_keys($inStock)) . "\n"; // 0, 2  (keys are preserved)

try.ar: غيّر الشرط لـ stock == 0 وشوف مين اللي بيفضل.
try.en: Change the condition to stock == 0 and see who remains.

short.ar: array_merge الأخير بيكسب في المفاتيح النصية، و + الأول بيكسب.
short.en: With array_merge the later value wins for string keys; with + the first one wins.

ar: array_merge كمان بتعيد ترقيم المفاتيح الرقمية.
en: array_merge also renumbers numeric keys.

example.code:
<?php
$defaults = ['color' => 'red', 'size' => 'M', 5 => 'five'];
$custom   = ['color' => 'blue', 'price' => 10, 5 => 'FIVE'];
print_r(array_merge($defaults, $custom));
// color => blue, size => M, 0 => five, price => 10, 1 => FIVE  (numeric keys renumbered)
print_r($defaults + $custom);
// color => red, size => M, 5 => five, price => 10  (left side wins)
print_r([...$defaults, ...$custom]);  // same result as array_merge

try.ar: بدّل ترتيب الـ arrays في + وشوف مين بيكسب.
try.en: Swap the order of the arrays in + and see who wins.

short.ar: الـ Anonymous محتاجة use، والـ Arrow بتاخد المتغيرات تلقائيًا.
short.en: Anonymous functions need use; arrow functions capture variables automatically.

ar: الـ Arrow تعبير واحد وبتاخد المتغيرات بالقيمة.
en: An arrow function is a single expression and captures variables by value.

example.code:
<?php
$taxRate = 0.14;
$prices = [100, 250, 40];

$anon = function ($p) use ($taxRate) { return $p * (1 + $taxRate); };
$arrow = fn($p) => $p * (1 + $taxRate);   // captures by value automatically

echo implode(', ', array_map($anon, $prices)) . "\n";  // 114, 285, 45.6
echo implode(', ', array_map($arrow, $prices)) . "\n"; // 114, 285, 45.6

$taxRate = 0.5;                            // changed after creation
echo $arrow(100) . "\n";                   // 114  - value captured at creation
$counter = 0;
$inc = function () use (&$counter) { $counter++; };
$inc(); $inc();
echo $counter . "\n";                      // 2

try.ar: جرب تعدّل $counter جوه arrow function وشوف إنه مش بيتغير بره.
try.en: Try modifying $counter inside an arrow function and see it does not change outside.

short.ar: دوال بترجع القيم واحدة واحدة.
short.en: Functions that return values one at a time.

ar: بتوفر الذاكرة مع البيانات الكبيرة.
en: They save memory with large data.

example.code:
<?php
function readLines(int $total): Generator {
    for ($i = 1; $i <= $total; $i++) {
        echo "[reading line $i]\n";
        yield $i => "row-$i";
    }
}
foreach (readLines(3) as $n => $row) {
    echo "$n: $row\n";
}
// [reading line 1] / 1: row-1 / [reading line 2] / 2: row-2 / [reading line 3] / 3: row-3

function counter(): Generator {
    $x = yield 'ready';
    echo "got $x\n";
}
$g = counter();
echo $g->current() . "\n"; // ready
$g->send('hello');         // got hello

try.ar: غيّر الـ 3 لـ 5 وشوف إن السطور بتتقرأ واحد واحد مش مرة واحدة.
try.en: Change 3 to 5 and see lines are read one at a time, not all at once.

short.ar: الأولى فيها تنفيذ جزئي، والتانية عقد.
short.en: The first has partial implementation; the second is a contract.

ar: الـ class تورث من واحدة بس وتنفذ كذا interface.
الـ interface ممكن يكون فيها ثوابت، و methods من غير تنفيذ.
en: A class extends only one class but can implement several interfaces.
An interface can hold constants and methods without implementation.

example.code:
<?php
interface Payable { public function pay(float $amount): string; }
abstract class Gateway implements Payable {
    public function __construct(protected string $name) {}
    public function describe(): string { return "Gateway: {$this->name}"; } // shared code
    abstract protected function fee(float $amount): float;                  // must implement
    public function pay(float $amount): string {
        $total = $amount + $this->fee($amount);
        return "{$this->name} charged $total";
    }
}
class Stripe extends Gateway {
    public function __construct() { parent::__construct('Stripe'); }
    protected function fee(float $a): float { return $a * 0.03; }
}
$g = new Stripe();
echo $g->describe() . "\n"; // Gateway: Stripe

$o->log('paid');

short.ar: self الـ class اللي اتكتب فيها الكود، static اللي اتنادت، parent الأب.

example.code:
<?php
class Model {
    public static function create(): static { return new static(); }   // late static binding
    public function who(): string { return self::class . ' / ' . static::class; }
}
class User extends Model {
    public function who(): string { return 'User > ' . parent::who(); }
}
echo get_class(Model::create()) . "\n"; // Model
echo get_class(User::create()) . "\n";  // User

<?php
class Settings {
    private array $data = [];
    public function __set($k, $v) { echo "set $k\n"; $this->data[$k] = $v; }
    public function __get($k) { return $this->data[$k] ?? "no $k"; }
    public function __isset($k) { return isset($this->data[$k]); }
    public function __call($m, $args) { return "$m(" . implode(',', $args) . ") not found"; }
    public function __toString(): string { return json_encode($this->data); }
    public function __invoke($x) { return $x * 2; }
}
$s = new Settings();
$s->theme = 'dark';             // set theme
echo $s->theme . "\n";          // dark
echo $s->lang . "\n";           // no lang
var_dump(isset($s->theme));     // bool(true)

<?php
namespace App\Models { class User { public function name() { return 'Nour'; } } }
namespace App\Services {
    use App\Models\User;
    class Greeter { public function hi(User $u) { return 'Hi ' . $u->name(); } }
}
namespace {
    // Simulation of a PSR-4 autoloader: App\ -> src/
    function psr4(string $class): string {
        return 'src/' . str_replace(['App\\', '\\'], ['', '/'], $class) . '.php';
    }
    echo psr4('App\Models\User') . "\n";      // src/Models/User.php
    echo psr4('App\Services\Greeter') . "\n"; // src/Services/Greeter.php
    $g = new App\Services\Greeter();
    echo $g->hi(new App\Models\User()) . "\n"; // Hi Nour
    echo App\Models\User::class . "\n";        // App\Models\User

<?php

}

    try {

<?php

en: Values are sent separately from the query.
Table and column names cannot be parameters, so check them against a whitelist.

example.code:
<?php
// Simulation: string concatenation is dangerous, a bound parameter is not
$input = "x' OR '1'='1";
$unsafe = "SELECT * FROM users WHERE email = '$input'";
echo $unsafe . "\n";
// SELECT * FROM users WHERE email = 'x' OR '1'='1'   <- returns every user!

$template = 'SELECT * FROM users WHERE email = :email';   // SQL and data are separate
$bound = ['email' => $input];
echo $template . "\n";                // SELECT * FROM users WHERE email = :email
echo 'Bound value (treated as data): ' . $bound['email'] . "\n";
// Real code: $pdo->prepare($template)->execute($bound);

$allowed = ['name', 'created_at'];
$requested = 'password; DROP TABLE users';
$sort = in_array($requested, $allowed, true) ? $requested : 'name'; // whitelist
echo "ORDER BY $sort\n";             // ORDER BY name

title.en: How do you handle file uploads safely?

ar: افحص الـ MIME من المحتوى، وخزن بره الـ public folder، وامنع تنفيذ الملفات.
en: Detect the MIME type from the content, store files outside the public folder, and block execution.

example.code:
<?php
// Simulation: validating an uploaded file (CLI has no $_FILES)
$file = ['name' => 'evil.php.jpg', 'size' => 3000000, 'error' => UPLOAD_ERR_OK];
function validateUpload(array $f): array {
    $errors = [];
    $allowed = ['jpg', 'png', 'pdf'];
    if ($f['error'] !== UPLOAD_ERR_OK) $errors[] = 'upload failed';
    if ($f['size'] > 2 * 1024 * 1024) $errors[] = 'file too large (max 2MB)';
    $ext = strtolower(pathinfo($f['name'], PATHINFO_EXTENSION));
    if (!in_array($ext, $allowed, true)) $errors[] = "extension $ext not allowed";
    if (substr_count($f['name'], '.') > 1) $errors[] = 'double extension suspicious';
    return $errors;
}
print_r(validateUpload($file));
// [0] => file too large (max 2MB)  [1] => double extension suspicious
echo 'Safe name: ' . bin2hex(random_bytes(6)) . '.jpg' . "\n"; // never trust the original name
// Real code also checks MIME with finfo and uses move_uploaded_file()

<?php
enum Status: string {

$none = null;
var_dump($none?->status?->label());          // NULL  (nullsafe operator)

short.ar: قيس الأول، وبعدين حسن الداتابيز والـ caching.

ar: فعل OPcache، واستخدم indexes، وتجنب N+1، واعمل caching بـ Redis.
انقل المهام الطويلة لـ queues، واعمل profiling بأدوات زي Xdebug أو Blackfire.
واستخدم composer install -o --no-dev في الـ production.
en: Enable OPcache, use indexes, avoid N+1 queries, and cache with Redis.
Move long tasks to queues, and profile with tools such as Xdebug or Blackfire.
Run composer install -o --no-dev in production.

example.code:
<?php
$ids = range(1, 50000);
function timeIt(callable $fn): float { $t = microtime(true); $fn(); return microtime(true) - $t; }

// Slow: in_array is O(n) per lookup
$slow = timeIt(function () use ($ids) {
    for ($i = 0; $i < 300; $i++) in_array(49999 - $i, $ids);
});
// Fast: isset on a flipped array is O(1)
$flip = array_flip($ids);
$fast = timeIt(function () use ($flip) {
    for ($i = 0; $i < 300; $i++) isset($flip[49999 - $i]);
});
echo 'isset faster than in_array: ' . ($fast < $slow ? 'yes' : 'no') . "\n"; // yes
$cache = [];
$get = function ($k) use (&$cache) { return $cache[$k] ??= strtoupper($k); }; // memoization
echo $get('a') . $get('a') . "\n"; // AA

short.ar: Framework لـ PHP مبني على MVC لبناء تطبيقات ويب و APIs.
short.en: A PHP framework built on MVC for web apps and APIs.

ar: بيوفر routing و Eloquent ORM و Blade و queues و authentication جاهزين.
فيه أداة Artisan للأوامر، و Service Container لإدارة الاعتماديات.
en: It ships routing, the Eloquent ORM, Blade, queues and authentication out of the box.
It includes the Artisan CLI and a service container for managing dependencies.

example.code:
<?php
// Simulation: what Laravel gives you out of the box (router + DB layer + templating) in a tiny form
class MiniApp {
    private array $routes = [];
    public function get(string $path, callable $handler): void { $this->routes['GET ' . $path] = $handler; }
    public function handle(string $method, string $path): string {
        $key = $method . ' ' . $path;
        return isset($this->routes[$key]) ? ($this->routes[$key])() : '404 Not Found';
    }
}
$app = new MiniApp();
$app->get('/', fn() => 'Welcome to the shop');
$app->get('/products', fn() => json_encode([['id' => 1, 'name' => 'Laptop'], ['id' => 2, 'name' => 'Phone']]));

echo $app->handle('GET', '/') . "\n";          // Welcome to the shop
echo $app->handle('GET', '/products') . "\n";  // [{"id":1,"name":"Laptop"},{"id":2,"name":"Phone"}]
echo $app->handle('GET', '/admin') . "\n";     // 404 Not Found

title.ar: اشرح الـ Request Lifecycle في Laravel.

short.ar: الطلب بيدخل من public/index.php ويعدي على الـ middleware والـ router لحد الـ controller ويرجع response.
short.en: A request enters through public/index.php, passes the middleware and router to a controller, and returns a response.

ar: index.php بيحمل الـ autoloader ويعمل bootstrap للتطبيق من bootstrap/app.php.
الـ Service Providers بتتسجل وتشتغل قبل معالجة الطلب.
الطلب بيعدي على الـ global middleware، وبعدين الـ router يختار الـ route وينفذ الـ middleware بتاعه والـ controller.
بعد إرسال الرد، الـ terminable middleware بيشتغل.
en: index.php loads the autoloader and bootstraps the app from bootstrap/app.php.
Service providers are registered and booted before the request is handled.
The request passes the global middleware, then the router picks a route and runs its middleware and controller.
After the response is sent, terminable middleware runs.

example.code:
<?php
// Simulation: Laravel request lifecycle (index.php -> kernel -> middleware -> router -> controller -> response)
function log_step(string $s): void { echo $s . "\n"; }

$controller = function (array $req) { log_step('4. Controller runs'); return 'Hello ' . $req['user']; };
$router = function (array $req) use ($controller) { log_step('3. Router matches route'); return $controller($req); };
$middleware = function (array $req) use ($router) {
    log_step('2. Middleware (auth) runs before');
    $res = $router($req);
    log_step('5. Middleware runs after (response)');
    return $res;
};
$kernel = function (array $req) use ($middleware) {
    log_step('1. Kernel boots providers');
    return $middleware($req);
};

$response = $kernel(['user' => 'Ahmed']);
echo "Response: $response\n"; // Response: Hello Ahmed

try.ar: شيل الـ middleware من السلسلة وشوف الخطوات اللي بتتشال من الـ output.
try.en: Remove the middleware from the chain and see which steps disappear from the output.

short.ar: أداة سطر الأوامر في Laravel.
short.en: Laravel's command-line tool.

ar: بتولد ملفات زي models و controllers و migrations بأوامر make.
بتشغل الـ migrations والـ queues والـ scheduler، و tinker بيفتح REPL للتجربة.
وتقدر تكتب أوامرك الخاصة.
en: It generates files such as models, controllers and migrations with make commands.
It runs migrations, queues and the scheduler, and tinker opens a REPL for experiments.
You can also write your own commands.

lessons.code:
php artisan make:model Post -mfc   # model + migration + factory + controller
php artisan migrate
php artisan tinker

example.code:
<?php
// Simulation: how Artisan maps "php artisan <command>" to command classes
abstract class Command {
    public string $signature;
    abstract public function handle(array $args): void;
}
class MakeController extends Command {
    public string $signature = 'make:controller';
    public function handle(array $args): void { echo "Created app/Http/Controllers/{$args[0]}.php\n"; }
}
class CacheClear extends Command {
    public string $signature = 'cache:clear';
    public function handle(array $args): void { echo "Application cache cleared.\n"; }
}
class Artisan {
    private array $commands = [];
    public function register(Command $c): void { $this->commands[$c->signature] = $c; }
    public function call(string $line): void {
        $parts = explode(' ', $line);
        $name = array_shift($parts);
        if (!isset($this->commands[$name])) { echo "Command \"$name\" is not defined.\n"; return; }
        $this->commands[$name]->handle($parts);
    }
}
$artisan = new Artisan();
$artisan->register(new MakeController());
$artisan->register(new CacheClear());
$artisan->call('make:controller OrderController'); // Created app/Http/Controllers/OrderController.php
$artisan->call('cache:clear');                      // Application cache cleared.
$artisan->call('make:model');                       // Command "make:model" is not defined.

title.en: How is a Laravel project structured?

short.ar: كل حاجة ليها مكان معروف، وده بيسهل الشغل في فريق.
short.en: Everything has a known place, which makes teamwork easier.

ar: app فيه الكود الأساسي زي Models و Http/Controllers.
routes فيه web.php و api.php و console.php.
config للإعدادات، database للـ migrations والـ seeders، و resources للـ views.
storage للـ logs والملفات المرفوعة، و public هو الوحيد المتاح للويب.
من Laravel 11 الـ middleware والـ exceptions بيتظبطوا في bootstrap/app.php.
en: app holds the core code, such as Models and Http/Controllers.
routes holds web.php, api.php and console.php.
config holds settings, database holds migrations and seeders, and resources holds views.
storage holds logs and uploads, and public is the only folder exposed to the web.
Since Laravel 11, middleware and exceptions are configured in bootstrap/app.php.

example.code:
<?php
// Simulation: Laravel folder structure and what each folder is for
$structure = [
    'app/Http/Controllers' => 'Handle requests',
    'app/Models'           => 'Eloquent models',
    'app/Providers'        => 'Bootstrapping / service providers',
    'bootstrap'            => 'Framework bootstrapping & cache',
    'config'               => 'Configuration files',
    'database/migrations'  => 'Schema changes',
    'public'               => 'Web root (index.php, assets)',
    'resources/views'      => 'Blade templates',
    'routes'               => 'web.php, api.php',
    'storage'              => 'Logs, cache, uploads',
    'tests'                => 'Feature & unit tests',
];
function where(array $s, string $keyword): void {
    foreach ($s as $path => $desc) {
        if (stripos($desc, $keyword) !== false || stripos($path, $keyword) !== false) {
            echo str_pad($path, 24) . "-> $desc\n";
        }
    }
}
where($structure, 'model');  // app/Models              -> Eloquent models
where($structure, 'config'); // config                  -> Configuration files

try.ar: دوّر على كلمة تانية زي "view" أو "test".

title.en: How do .env and config files work?

short.ar: .env للقيم اللي بتختلف بين البيئات، والـ config بيقرا منها.
short.en: .env holds values that differ per environment, and config files read from it.

ar: استخدم env() جوه ملفات config بس، وفي الكود استخدم config().
لأن بعد php artisan config:cache الـ env() بترجع null بره ملفات الـ config.
متعملش commit لملف .env.
en: Call env() only inside config files, and use config() everywhere else.
After php artisan config:cache, env() returns null outside config files.
Never commit the .env file.

example.code:
<?php
// Simulation: .env values feeding config() with defaults (env() -> config())
$env = ['APP_NAME' => 'Shop', 'APP_DEBUG' => 'true', 'DB_HOST' => '127.0.0.1'];
function env_(string $key, $default = null) {
    global $env;
    $v = $env[$key] ?? $default;
    return match ($v) { 'true' => true, 'false' => false, default => $v };
}
// config/app.php and config/database.php
$config = [
    'app' => ['name' => env_('APP_NAME', 'Laravel'), 'debug' => env_('APP_DEBUG', false)],
    'database' => ['host' => env_('DB_HOST', 'localhost'), 'port' => env_('DB_PORT', 3306)],
];
function config_(string $key) {
    global $config;
    $cur = $config;
    foreach (explode('.', $key) as $p) { $cur = $cur[$p]; }
    return $cur;
}
echo config_('app.name') . "\n";                          // Shop
var_dump(config_('app.debug'));                           // bool(true)
echo config_('database.port') . "\n";                     // 3306 (default, not in .env)

try.en: Change APP_DEBUG to false or remove DB_HOST and see the default.

title.en: How does routing work in Laravel?

short.ar: بيربط URL و HTTP method بـ controller أو closure.
short.en: Routes map a URL and an HTTP method to a controller or a closure.

ar: بيدعم parameters إجبارية واختيارية، وأسماء للـ routes بـ name().
الـ groups بتجمع prefix و middleware لكذا route.
routes/web.php للصفحات مع session و CSRF، و routes/api.php للـ APIs.
en: It supports required and optional parameters, and route names with name().
Groups share a prefix and middleware across several routes.
routes/web.php is for pages with session and CSRF; routes/api.php is for APIs.

example.code:
<?php
// Simulation: Laravel-style router with URL parameters and HTTP verbs
class Router {
    private array $routes = [];
    public function add(string $method, string $uri, callable $action): void {
        $regex = '#^' . preg_replace('#\{(\w+)\}#', '(?P<$1>[^/]+)', $uri) . '$#';
        $this->routes[] = [$method, $regex, $action];
    }
    public function dispatch(string $method, string $path): string {
        foreach ($this->routes as [$m, $regex, $action]) {
            if ($m === $method && preg_match($regex, $path, $match)) {
                $params = array_filter($match, 'is_string', ARRAY_FILTER_USE_KEY);
                return $action(...$params);
            }
        }
        return '404';
    }
}
$r = new Router();
$r->add('GET', '/users/{id}', fn($id) => "Show user #$id");
$r->add('POST', '/users', fn() => 'Create user');
$r->add('GET', '/posts/{post}/comments/{comment}', fn($post, $comment) => "Post $post / comment $comment");

echo $r->dispatch('GET', '/users/42') . "\n";                // Show user #42
echo $r->dispatch('POST', '/users') . "\n";                  // Create user
echo $r->dispatch('GET', '/posts/7/comments/3') . "\n";      // Post 7 / comment 3
echo $r->dispatch('DELETE', '/users/42') . "\n";             // 404

try.ar: ضيف route لـ DELETE /users/{id} وجرب تناديه.

short.ar: Laravel بتجيب الـ model من الداتابيز تلقائيًا من الـ parameter.
short.en: Laravel loads the model from the database automatically from the route parameter.

ar: لو اسم الـ parameter زي اسم المتغير ونوعه model، بيدور بالـ id وبيرجع 404 لو ملقاش.
تقدر تغير المفتاح بـ {post:slug} أو getRouteKeyName().
en: If the parameter name matches a type-hinted model variable, Laravel looks it up by id and returns 404 if it is missing.
You can change the key with {post:slug} or getRouteKeyName().

example.code:
<?php
// Simulation: route model binding - {user} in the URL becomes a User object (or 404)
class User {
    public function __construct(public int $id, public string $name) {}
    public static function find(int $id): ?User {
        $db = [1 => new User(1, 'Sara'), 2 => new User(2, 'Omar')];
        return $db[$id] ?? null;
    }
}
function bind(string $class, string $value) {
    $model = $class::find((int)$value);
    if ($model === null) { throw new RuntimeException('404 Not Found (ModelNotFoundException)'); }
    return $model;
}
// Route::get('/users/{user}', fn(User $user) => $user->name);
function showUser(User $user): string { return "Profile of {$user->name}"; }

foreach (['1', '2', '99'] as $segment) {
    try {
        echo showUser(bind(User::class, $segment)) . "\n";
    } catch (RuntimeException $e) {
        echo $e->getMessage() . "\n";
    }
}
// Profile of Sara
// Profile of Omar
// 404 Not Found (ModelNotFoundException)

try.ar: غيّر find لـ lookup بالـ name بدل الـ id (زي getRouteKeyName).
try.en: Change find to look up by name instead of id (like getRouteKeyName).

title.en: What kinds of controllers are there?

short.ar: classes بتجمع منطق التعامل مع الطلبات.
short.en: Classes that group request-handling logic.

ar: Route::resource بيعمل 7 routes للـ CRUD، و apiResource بيعمل 5 من غير create و edit.
الـ Single Action Controller فيه __invoke بس.
خلي الـ controller رفيع، وانقل المنطق التقيل لـ services أو actions.
en: Route::resource creates 7 CRUD routes; apiResource creates 5, without create and edit.
A single-action controller has only __invoke.
Keep controllers thin and move heavy logic into services or actions.

lessons.code:
Route::apiResource('posts', PostController::class);
// php artisan make:controller PostController --api

example.code:
<?php
// Simulation: controller types - basic, resource (CRUD methods) and single-action (__invoke)
class ProductController {
    public function index()          { return 'list products'; }
    public function show($id)        { return "show product $id"; }
    public function store()          { return 'store product'; }
    public function update($id)      { return "update product $id"; }
    public function destroy($id)     { return "delete product $id"; }
}
class SendInvoiceController {
    public function __invoke($order) { return "invoice sent for order $order"; }
}
// Route::resource('products', ProductController::class) maps verbs to methods:
$resourceMap = [
    'GET /products' => 'index', 'GET /products/{id}' => 'show', 'POST /products' => 'store',
    'PUT /products/{id}' => 'update', 'DELETE /products/{id}' => 'destroy',
];
$c = new ProductController();
foreach ($resourceMap as $route => $method) {
    echo str_pad($route, 22) . '-> ' . $c->$method(5) . "\n";
}
$single = new SendInvoiceController();
echo $single(1001) . "\n"; // invoice sent for order 1001

try.ar: ضيف method جديد زي create للـ resource وشوف الـ map.
try.en: Add a new method like create to the resource map.

short.ar: طبقة بتفلتر الطلب قبل أو بعد الـ controller.
short.en: A layer that filters the request before or after the controller.

ar: أمثلة: auth و throttle و verified.
الكود قبل $next($request) بيتنفذ قبل الـ controller، واللي بعده بيشتغل على الرد.
من Laravel 11 بتسجلها في bootstrap/app.php.
en: Examples: auth, throttle and verified.
Code before $next($request) runs before the controller; code after it works on the response.
Since Laravel 11 you register it in bootstrap/app.php.

example.code:
<?php
// Simulation: middleware pipeline (like Laravel's Pipeline) - each layer can stop or pass the request on
$auth = function (array $req, callable $next) {
    if (empty($req['user'])) { return '401 Unauthenticated'; }
    return $next($req);
};
$admin = function (array $req, callable $next) {
    if (($req['user']['role'] ?? '') !== 'admin') { return '403 Forbidden'; }
    return $next($req);
};
$logger = function (array $req, callable $next) {
    echo "LOG: {$req['path']}\n";
    return $next($req);
};
function run(array $middleware, array $req, callable $core): string {
    $pipeline = array_reduce(array_reverse($middleware), fn($next, $mw) => fn($r) => $mw($r, $next), $core);
    return $pipeline($req);
}
$core = fn($req) => 'Admin dashboard';
echo run([$logger, $auth, $admin], ['path' => '/admin', 'user' => null], $core) . "\n";                    // LOG: /admin, 401 Unauthenticated
echo run([$logger, $auth, $admin], ['path' => '/admin', 'user' => ['role' => 'user']], $core) . "\n";     // LOG: /admin, 403 Forbidden
echo run([$logger, $auth, $admin], ['path' => '/admin', 'user' => ['role' => 'admin']], $core) . "\n";    // LOG: /admin, Admin dashboard

try.ar: بدّل ترتيب $auth و $admin وشوف إيه اللي بيتغير.
try.en: Swap the order of $auth and $admin and see what changes.

short.ar: class مخصصة للـ validation والصلاحية قبل ما الطلب يوصل للـ controller.
short.en: A dedicated class for validation and authorization before the request reaches the controller.

ar: rules() فيها القواعد، و authorize() بتحدد مين مسموحله.
لو الـ validation فشل، بيرجع للصفحة بالأخطاء، أو JSON بـ 422 في الـ API.
استخدم $request->validated() عشان تاخد القيم المتحقق منها بس.
en: rules() holds the rules, and authorize() decides who is allowed.
If validation fails, the user is sent back with errors, or an API gets JSON with a 422.
Use $request->validated() to take only the validated values.

example.code:
<?php
// Simulation: Laravel validation rules ('required|email|min:3') applied to input
function validate(array $data, array $rules): array {
    $errors = [];
    foreach ($rules as $field => $ruleString) {
        $value = $data[$field] ?? null;
        foreach (explode('|', $ruleString) as $rule) {
            [$name, $arg] = array_pad(explode(':', $rule), 2, null);
            if ($name === 'required' && ($value === null || $value === '')) $errors[$field][] = "$field is required";
            if ($value === null || $value === '') continue;
            if ($name === 'email' && !filter_var($value, FILTER_VALIDATE_EMAIL)) $errors[$field][] = "$field must be a valid email";
            if ($name === 'min' && strlen($value) < (int)$arg) $errors[$field][] = "$field must be at least $arg characters";
        }
    }
    return $errors;
}
$rules = ['name' => 'required|min:3', 'email' => 'required|email', 'password' => 'required|min:8'];
print_r(validate(['name' => 'Al', 'email' => 'not-an-email', 'password' => 'secret'], $rules));
// name: must be at least 3 characters; email: must be a valid email; password: at least 8
echo count(validate(['name' => 'Ahmed', 'email' => 'a@b.com', 'password' => 'longpassword'], $rules)) . " errors\n"; // 0 errors

try.ar: اعمل input صح وبعدين غلّط حقل واحد بس.
try.en: Make the input valid, then break just one field.

It has layouts with @extends and @section, and components with <x-name>.
@csrf adds the token to a form.
